rationale: This checks whether the mapped observations can be produced from available records. Reconstructing stage queues and waiting times enables the procedure to run without changing its mechanism, evidential warrant, or target. Timestamp accuracy is a separate condition in the parent excerpt.

if_execution.verification_or_satisfaction_method: Check that available stage-transition records support calculating queue lengths at the chosen sampling intervals and waiting times from queue entry to pickup; demonstrate the reconstruction on sample records.
